Heterogeneous modeling based prosthesis design with porosity and material variation.

Medium AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Transferable Skim only simulation_case
Sudhir Kumar Singh, Puneet Tandon Journal of the mechanical behavior of biomedical materials 2018-11-01 10.1016/j.jmbbm.2018.07.029
单位: Mechanical Engineering Discipline﻿, PDPM Indian Institute of Information Technology, Design and Manufacturing﻿, Jabalpur, India. Electronic address: sudhirksingh@iiitdmj.ac.in.
通讯: Sudhir Kumar Singh @ Mechanical Engineering Discipline﻿, PDPM Indian Institute of Information Technology, Design and Manufacturing﻿, Jabalpur  |  Puneet Tandon @ Mechanical Engineering Discipline﻿, PDPM Indian Institute of Information Technology, Design and Manufacturing﻿, Jabalpur
相关性: 该论文通过异质建模设计多孔植入物以减少应力屏蔽，但缺乏增材制造实验验证和力学测试，与用户关注的AM生物医学方向部分相关。
边界: This paper does not include LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing, fatigue analysis, or as-built surface characterization.
动机· 通过异质设计减少植入物应力屏蔽并促进骨长入。
方法· 采用径向、轴向和混合变化的梯度孔隙率和材料分布进行建模。
结果· 径向变化模型在减少应力屏蔽和增强稳定性方面效果最佳。
验证· 通过静态分析和固结分析比较不同模型结果。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To minimize stress shielding and promote bone ingrowth through heterogeneous implant design with graded porosity and material variation.
Method· Prosthesis models with radial, axial, and mixed graded porosity and material distributions were designed and analyzed using finite element simulations.
Result· The radial variation model demonstrated the best performance in reducing stress shielding and improving implant stability.
Validation· The designs were validated through static structural analysis and consolidation analysis, comparing stress and strain distributions across models.

方法· 结合骨长入和骨传导的新型自适应有限元算法。

Motivation· To predict bone ingrowth in porous implants and mitigate stress shielding for improved long-term outcomes.
Method· Novel adaptive finite element algorithms incorporating bone ingrowth and osteoconduction, validated against in vivo histology.
Result· Lower-modulus Ti-Ta alloys and osteoconductive coatings markedly enhanced bone ingrowth and mechanical interlock.
Validation· Histological analysis of porous Ti6Al4V plugs implanted in ovine condyles confirmed simulation predictions.

通讯: Rashid K. Abu Al‐Rub @ Aerospace Engineering Department, Khalifa University of Science and Technology, Abu Dhabi 127788, United Arab Emirates e
相关性: 该论文研究了TPMS多孔钢结构的力学性能，但对生物医学植入物中的应力遮挡和疲劳性能缺乏探讨。
边界: This paper uses maraging steel (not biomedical alloy) by SLS (not LPBF), only static compression tests, no fatigue, no stress shielding analysis, no osseointegration or surface morphology.
动机· 利用增材制造实现具有可控拓扑的周期性多孔金属材料。
方法· 通过SLS制造不同TPMS拓扑和相对密度的马氏体钢样品，并进行压缩测试。

Motivation· Additive manufacturing enables fabrication of architected cellular materials with tunable structure-property relationships.
Method· Maraging steel samples with various TPMS topologies and relative densities were fabricated by selective laser sintering and tested under compression.
Result· Diamond TPMS lattice exhibited superior compressive mechanical properties among the tested topologies.
Validation· Print quality was assessed via electron microscopy and compressive properties were experimentally measured.

Motivation· To determine whether selective laser melting is suitable for fabricating dental superstructures.
Method· Mechanical properties of Ti-6Al-4V specimens produced by selective laser melting and numerically controlled milling were compared.

Validation· Validation was performed via tensile testing according to ISO 22674 standard.

An efficient, globally convergent method for optimization under uncertainty using adaptive model reduction and sparse grids

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling arxiv Transferable Save for project numerical_benchmark UQ
Matthew J. Zahr, Kevin T. Carlberg, Drew P. Kouri arXiv preprint 2018-11-01 link
相关性: 该方法通过自适应稀疏网格和降阶模型实现不确定条件下的高效优化，可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真采样问题。
边界: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical or implant design problems, nor does it address contact mechanics or stress shielding.
动机· 高效求解含不确定系数的PDE约束优化问题
方法· 结合自适应稀疏网格和投影降阶模型，通过信赖域方法管理近似误差
结果· 在最优流动控制问题中验证了全局收敛性并优于现有方法
验证· 数值基准测试
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To efficiently solve PDE-constrained optimization problems under uncertainty by managing two sources of inexactness.
Method· A trust-region method that adaptively refines a dimension-adaptive sparse grid and a projection-based reduced-order model, using an asymptotic error bound to guarantee global convergence.
Result· Numerical experiments on an optimal flow control problem demonstrate global convergence and superior performance over previous alternatives.
Validation· Numerical benchmark on a model problem from optimal flow control under uncertainty.

Accelerating Experimental Design by Incorporating Experimenter Hunches

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Save for project simulation_case Exp. validation
Cheng Li, Mazher Iqbal Mohammed, Ian Gibson, Santu Rana, Sunil Gupta et al. 2018-11-01 10.1109/icdm.2018.00041
单位: Deakin University, Geelong, PRaDA, Australia
通讯: Cheng Li @ Deakin University, Geelong, PRaDA, Australia
相关性: 该论文提出利用专家先验（单调趋势）加速贝叶斯优化，可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真采样问题。
边界: No FEA validation, no biomechanics context, no constraint handling or uncertainty quantification beyond standard GP.
动机· 利用实验者直觉（单调趋势）提升贝叶斯优化效率，减少昂贵实验次数。
方法· 两阶段高斯过程建模：第一阶段用单调性建模底层属性，第二阶段用虚拟样本建模目标优化函数。
结果· 在仿真和真实实验（聚合物纤维长度、多孔支架孔隙率）中比标准贝叶斯优化收敛更快。
验证· 通过仿真和两个真实实验案例验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To accelerate experimental design by incorporating expert prior knowledge of monotonic trends into Bayesian optimization.
Method· A two-stage Gaussian process model: first stage models the underlying property with monotonicity, second stage uses virtual samples from the first to model the target optimization function with a correction factor.
Result· The proposed method achieves faster convergence than standard Bayesian optimization in both simulations and real-world experiments on polymer fiber length and porous scaffold porosity.
Validation· Validated through simulations and two real-world experimental design problems (polymer fiber length and 3D porous scaffold porosity).

边界: This paper focuses on structural health monitoring (SHM) rather than biomedical implant design or biomechanics FEA, and does not address surrogate modeling for expensive simulations in implant optimization.
动机· 解决结构健康监测中损伤状态数据缺乏的问题
方法· 提出结合多级不确定性集成和模型差异校正的概率框架

Motivation· To address the lack of damage state data in structural health monitoring by using validated physical models to generate training data for machine learning.
Method· A probabilistic framework is proposed that integrates multi-level uncertainty quantification and statistical techniques to account for model discrepancies across sub-system models.
Result· The framework enables the generation of statistically representative predictions across damage states, facilitating the inference of decision bounds for SHM.
Validation· The paper presents a theoretical framework and discussion of application considerations without experimental or numerical validation.

边界: No implant or biomechanics application, no constraint handling, no multi-objective optimization, and no validation on biomedical FEA problems.
动机· 高效替代模型对复杂仿真器在早期设计阶段的应用至关重要。
方法· 采用稀疏高斯过程（SGP）降低计算复杂度，通过诱导点子集实现近似。

Motivation· Efficient surrogate modelling is crucial for enabling complex simulators and Monte Carlo methods in early design stages.
Method· Sparse Gaussian process emulators are employed to reduce computational complexity from O(N^3) to O(NM^2) using inducing points.
Result· Sparse GPs provide accurate predictions for structural dynamics simulators with quantified code uncertainty.
Validation· No experimental or numerical validation is presented; only conceptual discussion of performance.

Optimal plate fixation of distal femoral fractures in the presence of a well fixed cemented hip arthroplasty femoral stem.

Josh Kempthorne, David C Kieser, Cameron G Walker Hip international : the journal of clinical and experimental research on hip pathology and therapy 2018-11-01 10.1177/1120700018760243
单位: 1 Department of Orthopaedic Surgery and Musculoskeletal Medicine, University of Otago, Christchurch, New Zealand.
通讯: Cameron G Walker @ 2 Department of Engineering Science, University of Auckland, Auckland, New Zealand. [推断]
相关性: 本文研究了髋关节置换术后股骨远端骨折的钢板固定策略，通过机械测试评估了钢板与假体柄重叠长度对应变和断裂力的影响，但未涉及股骨近端应力遮挡或微动分析，与用户关注的髋关节假体力学方向部分相关。
边界: This paper does not quantify stress shielding in Gruen zones, does not report micromotion values with contact modeling, and does not compare intact vs implanted femur, focusing instead on plate fixation strain.
动机· 优化钢板与髋假体柄的相对位置，减少骨折风险
方法· 在复合骨模型上对不同钢板-柄重叠长度进行力学测试
结果· 钢板延伸至柄尖近端至少两个骨干直径时应变最小

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To determine the optimal lateral plate position relative to a cemented femoral stem for reducing inter-prosthetic strain and preventing distal femoral fractures.
Method· Mechanical testing of composite femurs with varying plate-stem overlap under torsion, axial compression, and 3-point lateral bending to measure strain and failure load.
Result· A plate extending at least two shaft diameters proximal to the stem tip exhibited the lowest strain, while a small gap led to highest strain and reduced fracture force.
Validation· Experimental validation using fourth-generation composite sawbones and a collarless polished cemented stem.

Result· The BSF18 coating improved wettability and significantly increased bone-to-implant contact and bone density at 2 weeks, but no difference was observed at 4 weeks.
Validation· In vivo canine study with implant stability quotient, bone-to-implant contact, and bone density measurements.

Motivation· To evaluate adherence to internal best-practice guidelines for prosthetic joint infection treatment and its impact on recurrence rates.
Method· Retrospective analysis of 36 TKA and 25 THA patients with PJI, comparing recurrence rates between guideline-concordant and guideline-discordant therapy groups.
Result· Guideline-concordant therapy significantly reduced recurrence in TKA (6.25% vs 45%), with a similar but non-significant trend in THA.
Validation· Clinical retrospective cohort study with statistical comparison of recurrence rates.
